playstyle.identity: Ziggs is a poke and siege mage who excels at destroying towers. His bombs zone enemies and his ultimate can nuke from across the map.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive empowers autos periodically (faster on abilities). Q bounces bombs. W satchel charges (knock up, destroys low towers). E scatters mines. R throws a mega bomb cross-map. Poke with Q, W to execute towers or escape, R to snipe fights.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Ziggs spikes with ability haste and AP. Luden's scales his poke. He's strong at siege and poking.

passive.name: Short Fuse
passive.summary: Periodically empower auto attack for bonus damage.
passive.details: Ziggs's next auto attack periodically deals bonus magic damage. Abilities reduce the cooldown.

abilities.name: Bouncing Bomb
abilities.summary: Throw a bomb that bounces up to twice.
abilities.details: Ziggs throws a bouncing bomb that explodes on hitting an enemy or after bouncing twice.

abilities.name: Satchel Charge
abilities.summary: Place a charge that knocks up enemies; can destroy low-health towers.
abilities.details: Ziggs places a satchel that he can detonate to knock up enemies. It can also be used to knock himself away or execute low-health towers.

abilities.name: Hexplosive Minefield
abilities.summary: Scatter mines that slow and damage enemies.
abilities.details: Ziggs scatters proximity mines that arm after a moment. Enemies who step on them take damage and are slowed.

abilities.name: Mega Inferno Bomb
abilities.summary: Throw a massive bomb at long range that deals huge damage.
abilities.details: Ziggs throws a huge bomb that travels across the map and deals massive damage in an area. More damage at the center.
